narrative:
Three-statement model for Bupa Global & UK (BU planning scope) from one chart of accounts. FY2025 actuals: revenue GBP 3.32B, cost of care GBP 2.46B (74.1%), underlying operating profit GBP 319M (9.6%), profit after tax GBP 213M. The FY2027 BU plan reaches GBP 3.80B revenue and GBP 365M underlying operating profit.

The balance sheet combines an insurance book — liabilities for incurred claims (including IBNR) and unearned premium — with a property-heavy provision estate of hospitals, care homes and dental practices. Free cash flow is close to break-even in the plan because cash generated is reinvested in capital expenditure, in line with Bupa's model of reinvesting profits into care.

Planning figures are a synthetic model calibrated for this demonstration, not Bupa reported results.

signals.title: Bupa Insurance Ltd combined operating ratio stable at 97%
signals.excerpt: The COR for Bupa Insurance Limited, which underwrites both domestic and international insurance, remained stable at 97%, against 94% for the Group.

signals.title: Group Solvency II coverage 189%
signals.excerpt: Own funds £6.8bn against an SCR of £3.6bn — above the 140–170% working range; a 2% worse loss ratio would reduce coverage to 182%.
